No. 2060/28 – FRIDAY MARCH 02, 2018
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the land acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government indents to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the lands to be acquired :

Preliminary plan : K 161 Situation Village : Paranthan GN Division : Paranthan KN/44 DS Division : Kandawalai District : Kilinochchi Province : Northern Lot No. 01 - Name of Land: Korakkankaddukkadu; Extent : 4.4387 Hectares
North: Lot No. 31 in PPYA 215; East: Lot 34 in PPYA 215; South: Lot 35 in PPYA 215; West: Lot 37 and 31 in PPYA 215.
All person interested in the aforesaid land on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before

me at Division at Secretariat, Kandawalai on the 16th Monday of April 2018 at 10.00 a.m., and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 09th of Monday April 2018 the nature of their interests in the land, the particular of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land amount of compensation and the details of the such amount.
G. NAHESWARAN, Divisional Secretary/Acquiring Officer, Kandawalai. Divisional Secretariat, Kandawalai, 26th February, 2018. 03 - 716
